pass_rule: answered + compliance_search actually called (router counters) + per-claim grounding (a quoted span that matches a store section by containment, or a resolving token: full id, cite_as token, unique prefix; multi-match quotes ground with all matches recorded; mistyped restatements of resolving citations absorbed; nothing repaired — an unmatched quote or id fails as written) + (relational questions) both sides cited. Absence questions: positively-asserted operator coverage must RESOLVE, by quote or by id (mechanical); whether resolvable coverage is real is the agent's reading, folded via --overrides and recorded on the row.
